interface.clock_reset: None: original interface has only in and pos.

semantics.function: pos is the minimum index i in [0,3] for which in[i] is 1; zero input produces pos=0.
semantics.priority_evidence: Original 10010000 example chooses bit 4 rather than bit 7.
semantics.timing: Combinational, no cycle latency or stored state, per original combinational circuit requirement.
semantics.initialization: No initialized state required; known binary inputs determine output after combinational settling.

verification.oracle: Independent explicit truth table derived from original lowest-set-bit requirement.
verification.coverage: All 16 binary input combinations, ascending and descending sweeps to exercise transitions and zero recovery.
verification.sampling: Sample one simulation time unit after each input change for combinational settling.
verification.success: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original specifies 16 possible combinations, with no X/Z behavior.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Verify all binary combinations; X/Z behavior is outside specified verification scope.
